slug: 2026-07-13 Malawi reaches 13.5M digital IDs as universal coverage comes into view

systems.owner: National Registration Bureau, supported by UNDP, the EU, Norway and Irish Aid
systems.tiers: national; more than 13.5 million issued, about 99 per cent of those aged 16 and over; over 150,000 enrolled April-June 2026 by Bureau teams in communities

note: About national identity enrolment; civil registration reforms and a five-year legal identity blueprint of 2025 are mentioned without any statement of how or where births or deaths are registered.
